basic_info.description: Rare Opportunity to own a Stylish Corner Unit in the Heart of the Mission District!  Experience modern city living at its finest with this exquisite 1-bedroom condo at Vida, ideally located on a quiet street just steps from vibrant Valencia and Mission Streets. This corner unit features an open-concept living space with sleek design and luxury finishes throughout.    Offering engineer wood flooring and bay windows sprawling with natural light and views of Twin Peaks, creating a welcoming and airy atmosphere. The gourmet kitchen features high end appliances which includes a Liebherr refrigerator, Bosch stovetop, oven, dishwasher, washer and dryer. The convenience of the in-unit laundry and a designated parking space make life hassle-free. Amenities includes a Front Desk attendant (available 7 days a week), rooftop deck with BBQ, fitness center, bike storage and a stylish lobby with common areas for residents' use.    Located in a prime location just steps away from popular restaurants, bars, farmer's markets, supermarkets and unique shops. Easy access to BART and Muni makes commuting a breeze.    Live in the heart of the city while enjoying a peaceful retreat. Don't miss out on this chance to own a modern, comfortable home in one of San Francisco's most dynamic neighborhoods!
